clue.text: Browser error closes one run

indicators.note: closes is read as encloses: the error wraps round the other pieces

parts.note: a gaffe is a social error or blunder
one is the Roman numeral I
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A web browser program throws an error and shuts down a running process.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Browser' looks like software but is an animal that browses, nibbling leaves from trees.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal that feeds on high tree leaves is a browser rather than a grazer, and the tallest one is the classic example.

clue.text: Girl's right to replace home in her money situation

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, so the clue reads Girl is ...

indicators.note: R is told to take the place of IN within the longer word

parts.note: one's finances are one's money situation
in means at home

explanation.surface: A girl's finances improve once she gets her rights in place of staying at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'her' is a link pointing back to the girl. Replacing IN by R in FINANCES leaves F-R-ANCES.
explanation.definitionFit: Frances is a female first name, so the clue's girl is one such named person.

clue.text: Unemployed, ready to unravel?

definitions.meaning: read literally, a thread end hanging free can be pulled to unpick knitting

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means having nothing to occupy you, and taken literally describes a dangling thread end.

clue.text: Part of vault architect hasn't finished

indicators.note: the last letter of the abbreviation is left off

parts.note: RIBA, the Royal Institute of British Architects, is a crossword stand-in for an architect

explanation.surface: An architect leaves part of the vaulted ceiling incomplete.
explanation.walkthrough: A member of RIBA (the British architects' professional body) puts the letters after their name.
explanation.definitionFit: A vaulted ceiling is framed by projecting arched bands of stone, each one called a rib.

clue.text: Espionage novel held to be short of substance

indicators.note: the spying word holds the novel's title inside it

parts.note: espionage is spying, to spy
Kim is Rudyard Kipling's novel, itself about espionage in British India

explanation.surface: A spy novel is judged to be thin on content.
explanation.walkthrough: Fittingly, Kim is a novel of espionage, the Great Game.
explanation.definitionFit: Something skimpy is meagre or scanty, lacking in quantity or content.

clue.text: Sailor hangs in turn — he swings on rope

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a crossword sailor

indicators.note: in turn signals the word for hangs is turned round

parts.note: relies, as in hangs on or depends on someone

explanation.surface: A sailor dangles from the rigging, swinging on a rope as each takes a turn.
explanation.definitionFit: One descending a cliff by a rope tied above swings on that rope as he goes down.

clue.text: Stiflers of dissent still shattering plot to kill American

parts.note: though and still both mean nevertheless

indicators.note: shattering breaks the word plot into pieces to be rearranged

parts.note: to ice is American slang for to kill

explanation.surface: Dissident-crushers are still smashing a plot to murder an American.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link. The rearrangement of PLOT gives TPOL here.
explanation.definitionFit: In Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four this force punishes forbidden ideas, so it suppresses dissent.

clue.text: Check behind building material, something for concrete?

parts.note: to rein is to check or restrain
for, as in being behind or in support of a cause
cement is a building material

explanation.surface: Keep checking behind the building materials for something to go in the concrete.
explanation.definitionFit: Steel bars set inside concrete to strengthen it are called by this general term for added strength.

clue.text: Chopin's first go in one new genre of music

indicators.note: in places the initial and the go inside the reworked word
new tells us the word one is made into a fresh arrangement
first takes just the opening letter of the composer's name

parts.note: a go is a turn

explanation.surface: Chopin's first attempt at a new type of music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns ONE into NOE, and 'in' sets the other pieces inside it. Fittingly, Chopin wrote many of these night pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A dreamy piano piece evoking night forms a recognised musical category.

clue.text: Hat man used to obscure side of face

indicators.note: the man covers up one side, here the end letter, of the face word

parts.note: a clock is a face, as in a clock face
he is a man

explanation.surface: A man wears a hat pulled down to hide one side of his face.
explanation.definitionFit: A bell-shaped close-fitting women's hat of the 1920s goes by this French name.

clue.text: Repeatedly bash meat, chopping the end

indicators.note: the final letter is cut off the meat

parts.note: lamb is a meat

explanation.surface: Tenderise meat by bashing it repeatedly, then chop off the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To lam is a dated verb meaning to beat or thrash someone hard.

clue.text: Frightful witch locks away mirror, magic regularly going wrong

indicators.note: the witch locks the other pieces inside her

parts.note: a hag is an ugly old woman or witch

indicators.note: every other letter of the two words is taken

parts.note: sin is going wrong, wrongdoing

explanation.surface: A frightening witch locks up her magic mirror, but the spell keeps going wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: Every other letter of MIRROR MAGIC gives IRRAI.
explanation.definitionFit: Something terrifying makes your hair stand on end, the idiom behind the hyphenated word.

clue.text: Like washing pegged out endlessly in Scottish town

indicators.note: endlessly drops the last letter

parts.note: washing pegged on a line is air-dried

explanation.surface: Laundry hung out on the line in a Scottish town.
explanation.walkthrough: Airdrie is a town east of Glasgow.
explanation.definitionFit: Airdrie is a town in North Lanarkshire, Scotland.

clue.text: Arrange to eavesdrop on big beast, a cause of irritation

parts.note: to bug a room is to set it up for eavesdropping
a bear is a big beast

explanation.surface: Planting a listening device on a large animal proves irritating.
explanation.definitionFit: A pet hate or source of annoyance is called a bugbear.

clue.text: Port extremely good — any number request to circulate it

indicators.note: extremely takes the extreme, outside, letters
the request goes round the number, it

parts.note: to ask is to request
N is the algebraic symbol for any number

explanation.surface: Fine port: ask for any amount to be passed round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' suggests the passed decanter, but it is a harbour city in Poland.
explanation.definitionFit: Gdansk is a major Baltic seaport in northern Poland.

clue.text: In repose, Muslim perhaps who has feet on ground

indicators.note: In at the start says the Muslim goes inside the repose word

parts.note: rest is repose
Ali is a common Muslim name, so one example of a Muslim

explanation.surface: A Muslim at rest is a down-to-earth person.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone practical and down-to-earth, with feet on the ground, is a realist.

clue.text: Very simple pudding and what eating it constitutes?

parts.note: a fool is a British dessert of fruit purée folded into cream
the saying goes that the proof of the pudding is in the eating

explanation.surface: An easy pudding, and the proof is in the eating.
explanation.definitionFit: Anything so simple that no one could get it wrong is idiot-proof.

clue.text: Language very lacking in poetry

indicators.note: lacking means the abbreviation is taken out

parts.note: verse is poetry

explanation.surface: Language very lacking in poetic quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Erse is an old name for the Gaelic language of Scotland or Ireland.

clue.text: Fine battle raging, trivially wounded?

indicators.note: raging suggests wild disorder, so the letters are thrown about

explanation.surface: A fierce battle rages, leaving soldiers only lightly injured.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally bitten by tiny insects, so hurt in a trivial way; usually meaning shabby.

clue.text: Frenchman who's apparently left band replaced

indicators.note: what is left of the two words once outer letters are stripped

explanation.surface: A French musician seems to have quit the band and been replaced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'who's' is a link. Strip B and PLACED from 'band replaced' and the Frenchman is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Andre is a common French man's first name, so a typical Frenchman.

clue.text: Heart sick over composer

parts.note: core means heart, centre

indicators.note: in a down clue over turns the word upwards

parts.note: ill means sick

explanation.surface: Heartsick about a composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Arcangelo Corelli was an Italian Baroque violinist and composer.

clue.text: Small group of families upset American immigration point?

indicators.note: in a down clue upset turns the letters upside down

parts.note: a border is where immigrants cross into a country

explanation.surface: An American is upset at the immigration checkpoint.
explanation.walkthrough: In biology a family is a rank of classification, and a suborder groups a few of them.
explanation.definitionFit: In taxonomy, a rank below an order and containing a few families is a suborder.

clue.text: Exaggerate grades and gain improperly

indicators.note: improperly tells us the letters are put in a wrong order

explanation.surface: Inflate grades and gain unfairly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' only joins the two words of fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: To aggrandise is to make something seem greater than it is, to exaggerate it.

clue.text: Finished telling story showing some coincidence

parts.note: over means finished
telling stories is lying

explanation.surface: Done with telling stories, revealing a coincidence.
explanation.walkthrough: Coincidence here is the spatial sense: occupying the same place, one thing lying over another.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying on top of something means partly occupying the same space, a coincidence in position.

clue.text: Cut everyone up, being worsted

parts.note: to prune is to cut back

indicators.note: in a down clue up reads the word bottom to top

parts.note: all means everyone

explanation.surface: Cut everyone up, ending up beaten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being' is a link. 'worsted' looks like 'beaten' but is a woollen cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Prunella is a strong worsted fabric once used for clergy gowns and shoe uppers.

clue.text: One newly settling money on daughter at last

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed above the next piece

parts.note: income is money earned

indicators.note: at last takes the final letter

explanation.surface: A newcomer puts money aside for his daughter at last.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has recently moved into an area is an incomer.

clue.text: Touching ceramic, pretend to break it

indicators.note: pretend is to break into the ceramic word, splitting it

parts.note: a tile is a piece of ceramic
to act is to pretend

explanation.surface: Feeling a ceramic and pretending to break it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tactile relates to the sense of touch, as in touching things.

clue.text: To be held in both hands, an advantage for book

indicators.note: the advantage is held between the two letters

parts.note: L and R are left and right, both hands
an edge is an advantage

explanation.surface: An advantage worth gripping in both hands for a book.
explanation.definitionFit: A ledger is an account book recording transactions.

clue.text: Escort a minimum of three people?

parts.note: us is at least two people, and adding her makes three or more
us is at least two people, and adding her makes three or more

explanation.surface: Hiring an escort for a group of at least three people.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'three people' is split as two words for people.
explanation.definitionFit: To usher is to escort or show someone to a seat.

clue.text: Beetle potentially something to eat

definitions.meaning: a larva that may develop into a beetle

explanation.definitionFit: A grub is a beetle larva, and slang for food.
